rationale: Unblock the design critic (features_open/018, owner-raised 2026-07-24, owner-directed to BUILD 2026-08-25 in the leopardess lane after being independently re-proposed five times unbuilt). Phase 1 of the already-owner-approved design (vigilant_designer_offer_analysis PLAN_2026-08-02 Programme A Phase 2) is an agent whose critique step calls execute_vision_prompt over render-audit screenshots. That action downloads screenshots via params.StorageClient, which agentbase builds only when the spawned pod receives IMAGE_BUCKET, which happens only when the agent type is in the hardcoded Go slice isStorageEnabledAgent (spawn_actions.go) or its category is orchestrator/code-driven. Without membership every run fails 'no storage client' — bugs_open/243 measured 26/26 sweep-spawned failures for tool-acceptance-agent before its identical grant. Membership in this slice is the sanctioned per-type grant under the 2026-08-08 ruling that keeps bucket config OFF the shared chassis deployment; the alternative escape hatch (seeding category='orchestrator') was considered and rejected in the approved plan — it gives the agent orchestrator semantics it does not have, and a mis-categorised agent is folklore. The Go change is deliberately the ONLY code change in this submission: the seed (a sql_for_agents migration, itself council-scope) follows separately and must not apply before a build carrying this line is live — the ordering trap 243 documented, restated in the added comment.

plan.risks: Near-zero blast radius by construction: the function is a membership test over a literal slice, and the new member is an agent type that exists nowhere yet (zero agent_definitions rows, zero seeds) — no live spawn path can match it until the seed lands, so behaviour is byte-identical for every existing agent. The real risk is ORDERING, not code: if the seed applies before a build carrying this line rolls, every run fails 'no storage client' exactly as bugs_open/243 measured — mitigated by the comment at the grant site and by holding the seed until the stamp of a live chassis confirms the line shipped. A reviewer should check the string matches the seed's agent type exactly when that seed is later submitted (a mismatch fails silently as a missing grant).
